P01.rationale: No human portrait or founder image appears anywhere on the page; it is entirely text-based.

P05.rationale: There are no case study sections or client portraits present on this page.

P07.rationale: No press logos, rating cards, review grid, or testimonials are present; the page contains no social-proof apparatus.

P10.rationale: The '50 %' statistic is rendered at a large display size but functions as a data callout rather than a purely decorative ghost numeral or oversized quote glyph.

P11.rationale: No charts, before/after visuals, or cost-math diagrams are present; the '50 %' is a standalone text callout without any visualisation frame.

P12.rationale: The page has a structured two-column numbered list and a headline block, but the lower third is largely empty, preventing a truly dense, magazine-quality fill.

P13.rationale: A subtle warm off-white/cream paper texture is used as the background, providing a mild atmospheric quality rather than flat white.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photograph is used on this page, so scrim treatment is not applicable.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book) appears anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The page is text-only with no imagery at all, so there is no stock photography to penalise, though the absence of specific visuals keeps it generic in feel.

N08.rationale: The bottom quarter of the page below the '50 %' callout is largely empty, creating a noticeable dead-whitespace region.

N10.rationale: There are no photographs on the page, so there is no risk of text sitting on a busy photo without a scrim.
